references.style='custom' because the guide specifies a MODIFIED APA 7th ed. (author-date) style, which has no dedicated enum slot (nlm/ama/vancouver/custom). Quote: 'IJSNEM follows a modified version of the style laid out in the Publication Manual of the American Psychological Association (APA), 7th ed.' In-text = author name(s) + date in parentheses (paren); reference list alphabetical, un-numbered; journal titles spelled out in full (journal_abbrev=full).

et_al_threshold=2 encodes the guide's IN-TEXT rule ('where there are more than two authors, the first author's name can be followed by et al.'), i.e. list up to 2 authors then et al. The reference-LIST author-count threshold is not stated (defers to the APA manual).
include_doi=false: the guide's three worked reference examples show NO DOI, and it is a 'modified' APA; DOI inclusion not explicitly required.

Article-type mapping: 'Original Research'->original_research; 'Case Study'->case_report AND case_series (guide references 'subject(s)', permitting >1 subject; identical 2,000-word/25-ref/4-media rules); 'Scholarly Review' (explicitly 'including narrative reviews and meta-analyses')->review + narrative_review + systematic_review, all sharing the 5,000-word/75-ref/8-media Scholarly Review limits.

Types OMITTED (no clean enum slot / not standard author submission): 'Rapid Communication' (author-submittable expedited original research, 2,000 words, 25 refs, 4 figs/tables — could not add without colliding with original_research); 'Methodology Review' (follows Scholarly Review rules; usually commissioned); '10 Questions; 10 Experts' (4,000 words, symposium summary, commissioned); 'Other'/invited editorials (commissioned). Journal also publishes Letters to the Editor/Responses but the guide gives no author-formatting instructions for them.

COMBINED media caps (schema stores figures_max and tables_max separately, but the real constraint is a combined total): Original Research = 10 figures AND/OR tables total; Case Study/Series = 4 total; Scholarly Review = 8 total. Quote (Original Research): 'A total of 10 figures and/or tables may be used'.
Word limits exclude title page, abstract, acknowledgments, references, figures, tables. Original Research target is 3,000 words with an ABSOLUTE MAXIMUM of 4,000 (encoded the 4,000 hard cap).

Abstract: max 250 words, ONE continuous paragraph WITHOUT subheadings (structured=false) for all types. Quote: 'The abstract should be a maximum of 250 words and be written in one continuous paragraph without subheadings.'
Keywords: exactly 3 keywords/phrases NOT included in the title. Quote: 'Include three keywords or phrases not included in the manuscript title.' Case and separator unspecified (null).

Title max 25 words (no character limit stated). Running title limited to 8 WORDS (schema has running_title_max_chars only, which is word-limited here -> null; the 8-word cap is noted). Quote: 'The title of the paper should be limited to 25 words. The running title ... should be limited to 8 words.'

Layout: double-spaced; continuous line numbers; page numbers in upper-right; each table/figure on a separate page; figure legends aggregated on a separate page at the conclusion of the references (legends_location=figure_legends_section). Manuscript element order: (1) title page; (2) abstract and keywords; (3) text; (4) acknowledgments/authorships/funding/conflicts; (5) references; (6) tables; (7) figure legends; (8) figures.

Font family, font size, margins, page size, alignment, first-line indent, and heading case/style are NOT specified in the guide (all null). blinding.separate_title_page=true reflects the required separate title page ('The manuscript must have a separate title page'), but review is NON-anonymous ('Manuscripts are read by an editor and two reviewers; reviews will not be anonymous'), so no body/metadata scrubbing is required (scrub_*=false, double_blind=false).

Figures: black-and-white/grayscale only (no color); photos min 300 dpi, line art/graphs/charts/diagrams min 600 dpi (min_dpi=300 encoded, 600 tier noted); formats TIFF/PDF/JPEG. Alt text (<=250 chars) required per figure in a separate document (WCAG accessibility).

Declarations: funding sources and conflicts of interest must be declared at end of text; per-author CRediT contribution paragraph required; human/animal studies require an ethics-approval + informed-consent statement. Case studies additionally require written subject permission-for-publication (signed consent form) -> patient_consent applies to case_report/case_series (noted, not added to global 'required').

cover_letter_required=false conservatively: the guide REFERENCES a cover letter for CONDITIONAL disclosures (AI-tool use if used; justification for exceeding figure/table caps; Rapid Communication novelty case) but states no unconditional 'a cover letter is required' rule. ScholarOne submission also requires authors to supply >=2 suggested peer-reviewer names/emails.

orcid_required=false: ORCID not mentioned in the guide. highlights_required=false: no Elsevier-style Highlights; instead a 'Nontechnical Summary' (<=1,000 words, plain language) is requested only at REVISION, not initial submission.

AI policy: generative-AI use must be disclosed in the cover letter and the manuscript; AI cannot be an author; AI-assisted peer review is prohibited. PRESENT 2020 checklist recommended for sport-nutrition trials. tables.caption_position='above' inferred from 'headings should be included with each table' (general instructions); numbering (arabic/roman) not stated -> null.
